name: tmux-subagents
description: Pi or Claude Code orchestrates Pi- or Claude-backed children through harness-native lifecycle adapters.
requirements: tmux and bash for the Claude-to-Pi bridge
Python 3.10+ standard library and POSIX no-follow filesystem support for instruction updates

installs.claudeInstructionAlias: verify/preserve $CLAUDE_HOME/rules/AGENTS.md -> canonical AGENTS; never write through it

safety.nativeLifecycle: Pi and Claude children use their parent harness's native lifecycle whenever available
safety.bridgeScope: file and watcher signaling is limited to Claude-to-Pi
safety.claudePermissions: auto-permissions-v1 capability; classifier-based checks, never bypass; option parsing terminates before task text
safety.legacyMigration: exact released skill signatures only; retired skills are backed up outside discovery roots; legacy instruction filenames are detection-only and require separate native withdrawal proof
safety.instructionRecovery: private ordinary-document journal and holding/payload recovery; conditional on recorded after-state, never concurrent overwrite
safety.negativeExamples: maintainer-only; excluded from generated child prompts
